Nvidia Developing 1-Trillion-Parameter AI Model Nemotron 4

Nvidia is reportedly developing a new artificial intelligence model named Nemotron 4, which is expected to have one trillion parameters. This new model is designed to compete with other leading AI models currently available. The development was reported by Business Standard and Deccan Chronicle.
